career_ladder.note: Judicial officers in Karnataka are recruited under the Karnataka Judicial Service (Recruitment) Rules, 2004 under the administrative superintendence of the High Court of Karnataka, with revised pay scales governed by the Second National Judicial Pay Commission (SNJPC).

exam_scheme.note: Direct recruitment conducted by the High Court of Karnataka consisting of Preliminary Examination (OMR Screening), Main Written Examination (4 descriptive papers of 100 marks each), and Viva-voce Test (100 marks).

stages.source_label: Karnataka Judicial Service (Recruitment) Rules & Civil Judge Examination Scheme

papers.paper_name: Part A: Civil Law (CPC, Contract Act, Specific Relief, Transfer of Property, Indian Constitution, Karnataka Rent Act)
papers.qualifying_threshold: 50% for GM/OBC (50 marks); 40% for SC/ST (40 marks); top 1:25 candidates shortlisted for Mains

papers.paper_name: Part B: Criminal Law (CrPC, IPC, Indian Evidence Act)
Part C: General Knowledge, Reasoning and Mental Ability

stages.source_label: High Court of Karnataka Civil Judge Recruitment Rules (Mains Syllabus)

papers.paper_name: Paper 1: Translation Paper (English to Kannada 50 marks; Kannada to English 50 marks)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 40% in each paper (35% for SC/ST) and 50% aggregate (40% for SC/ST)

papers.paper_name: Paper 2: Law Paper I (Civil Law - Code of Civil Procedure, Principles of Pleading, Constitution of India)
Paper 3: Law Paper II (Criminal Law - Code of Criminal Procedure, Indian Penal Code, Indian Evidence Act)
Paper 4: Law Paper III (Framing of Issues & Judgment Writing in Civil and Criminal Cases)

stages.source_label: High Court of Karnataka Viva-Voce Guidelines

papers.qualifying_threshold: 40% (40 marks out of 100) for General/OBC; 35% (35 marks out of 100) for SC/ST

financial_package.note: Salary computed as per the Second National Judicial Pay Commission (SNJPC) revised pay matrix for Subordinate Judiciary (Scale J-1: ₹77,840–₹1,36,520; Entry Basic Pay ₹77,840) as accepted by the Government of Karnataka pursuant to Supreme Court directives. Applies standardized project constant 58% DA as of 2025-07-01.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Second National Judicial Pay Commission (SNJPC) Recommendation Matrix and Karnataka Government Notification
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated with Entry Basic Pay of ₹77,840 at mandatory 58% DA (₹45,147) plus Judicial HRA / official government bungalow allowance, sumptuary allowance (₹4,000), robe allowance, and conveyance allowance, less statutory pension and income tax deductions.
official_perks: Designated judicial bungalow / official residence or judicial HRA
Official vehicle / conveyance allowance with driver
Sumptuary allowance and library allowance as per SNJPC
Free electricity and water quota as per judicial service rules
Comprehensive medical cover for officer and dependents under judicial regulations
Robe allowance and telephone / broadband reimbursement
